text:
The guard was very rude. Food was okay. Atmosphere was bad as it was crowded with drunkards.

Our train was canceled suddenly and we can't find any hotels so we tried finding a place during the very late hour. So, we came here and ordered some chicken fillet and cheese dip here. The taste was normal.

One of our friend was so sleepy and I was enjoying the meal. Then, the staff came to wake my friend up. He said that you have to eat to stay here which was exactly what I was doing. If he wanna get rid of us that much, just say it clearly that you don't want us here with a reasonable answer. May be he's nothing but a child playing with his small authority in the McDonald's.

PS. I think the guard was there not to help and protect anyone but to speed up people eating. However, the guard was not courage enough to actually state it clearly.

Definitely won't come back
author: Csen Texr

text: Food service is awful. Bacon and egg mcmuffin meal where the muffin was noticeably very small, very hard and dry with an under cooked piece of bacon in it. When I asked for a replacement was told there is no more bacon so I paid for extra beef patties which came literally SWIMMING in grease. Once patted down with 3 napkins I was able to eat them unlike the muffin that was not suitable for human consumption. The millionaire latte was filled with far too much thick syrup. I recommend eating ANYWHERE else. I'm hoping I survive the little I did eat and am alive to give somewhere else a better review. I also over heard another customer being told there is no chicken today! Really is the worst place ever. I'm only giving 1 star because minus stars is not an option
author: Miztei Mendez

text:
Avoid if you're disabled!

The few seats downstairs were full. I struggle to stand and climb stairs so I asked a staff member if I could order and someone could bring us the food up so I wouldn't have to stand and carry the food upstairs. The staff member said 'impossible', so there you have it, the staff at this establishment find it impossible to accommodate a reasonable request that would've allowed me to eat with dignity. I went elsewhere.
Perhaps I shouldn't have been surprised as when I arrived here the staff member in question was having a full on argument with another customer.
author: Accessibility Fails

text: I was excited to grab a quick lunch on my busy day, but my excitement quickly turned to disappointment. Upon opening the wrap package, I was disheartened to find it was just chicken and wrap – completely plain with no visible vegetables. Despite my initial dismay, I ate it anyway, only to find a touch of sauce at the very end of the wrap. Overall, I am not happy with this meal.
author: TouchSoul
